rows.jp: 屋上に来てみた。
rows.en: I've come up to the roof.

ghs.en: I tried going to the rooftop.

rows.jp: 時刻は１０時をまわっている。
rows.en: It's past ten.

ghs.en: Present time is past 10AM.

rows.jp: どうせ……授業があるわけでもない。
rows.en: Not that there are any classes to miss...

ghs.en: After all... we have no classes in this situation.

rows.jp: ただ学校空間に触れたかっただけだ。
rows.en: I just wanted to feel like I was at school.

ghs.en: I only wanted to come into contact with the space of the school itself.

rows.jp: なんてことのない日常を、味わいたかっただけ。
rows.en: To savor one perfectly ordinary day.

ghs.en: Just to taste the quiet normal unruffled daily life.

rows.jp: 精神安定剤のように―――
rows.en: Like taking a sedative—

ghs.en: Like an ataractic---

rows.jp: 屋上には誰もいない……。
rows.en: But the roof is empty...

ghs.en: There is no one on the rooftop...

rows.en: “Hm?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hm?"

rows.jp: でもなかった。
rows.en: Not quite.

ghs.en: I mean there wasn't.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese negates the preceding claim that nobody was present; the English repeats that claim instead of reversing it.

rows.jp: 部活……ってやつか。
rows.en: Club activities... so that's what this is.

ghs.en: Club... that's what she's here for.

rows.jp: アンテナを見あげる。
rows.en: I look up at the antenna.

ghs.en: I look up at the antenna.

rows.jp: 世界から人が消えて。
rows.en: Everyone vanished from the world.

ghs.en: People have vanished from the world.

rows.jp: 俺たちは結束することもできず、個人だった。
rows.en: We couldn’t even come together. We remained individuals.

ghs.en: And we were individuals, unable to stand in unity.

rows.jp: 結束していたとしても無力さに変わりはないだろうけど。
rows.en: Not that coming together would have made us any less powerless.

ghs.en: Though I believe this powerlessness would not change even if there had been unity.

rows.jp: ……個々の問題ともなればこのヘビィな状況は、心を軋ませた。
rows.en: But once that weight became ours to bear alone, it ground away at the heart.

ghs.en: ...with these individual problems, this heavy situation would make any heart creak.
Taichi: "......"

rows.jp: 直射日光、危ないかな。
rows.en: Is it safe to sleep in direct sunlight?

ghs.en: Won't direct sunlight exposure be dangerous?

rows.jp: そばに目覚まし時計が転がっていた。
rows.en: An alarm clock lies nearby.

ghs.en: An alarm clock was casually dropped nearby.

rows.jp: 先輩の私物だろうか。
rows.en: Maybe it's Mimi's.

ghs.en: Seems to be Senpai's private property.

rows.jp: アラームを五分後にセットする。
rows.en: I set it to go off in five minutes.

ghs.en: I set the alarm for five minutes from now.

rows.jp: これで起きてくれるだろう。
rows.en: That should wake her.

ghs.en: This should wake her up,

rows.jp: みみ先輩に寝ぼすけ属性はないのだ。
rows.en: Mimi isn't the type to sleep through an alarm.

ghs.en: because Mimi-senpai does not have the Sleepyhead Character Attribute.

rows.jp: 落下＆自殺防止用の金網に、指をひっかけながら階段に向かう。
rows.en: On my way to the stairs, I trail my fingers along the wire fence meant to prevent falls—and suicides.

ghs.en: Running my fingers held over the netting for fall & suicide prevention, I move towards the stairs.

rows.en: “Hm?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hm?"

rows.jp: 一箇所、金網が脆くなっていた。
rows.en: One section of the fence has gone brittle.

ghs.en: In one place, that one place, the wire mesh had become fragile.

rows.jp: 軽く押すと、めきめきと倒れていく。
rows.en: At the slightest push, it buckles with a series of cracks.

ghs.en: A light press and it gives in, conspicuously.

rows.jp: 体重をかけたら落ちてしまいそうだ。
rows.en: Put any weight on it and it would give way.

ghs.en: If I were to put my body's weight on it I would just fall down.

rows.jp: 「危ねー」
rows.en: “That's dangerous.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Dangerooous."

rows.jp: 夢幻に生きる者の多い群青では、大変な管理問題だぞ。
rows.en: At Gunjo, where so many people live in dreams, that's a major safety hazard.

ghs.en: In Gunjou, where so many people live in their own fantasies, that's a serious management problem.
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: ま、今のメンバーなら平気か。
rows.en: Still, this crowd should be okay.

ghs.en: Well, with our members we should be alright.

rows.jp: 全員、日常生活に支障はないはずだ。
rows.en: They should all be able to manage daily life.

ghs.en: None of our members had impediments to our normal daily life.

rows.jp: ゆっくりと階段に向かう。
rows.en: I make my way slowly toward the stairs.

ghs.en: Slowly I head towards the stairs.

rows.jp: 扉をあける。
rows.en: I open the door.

ghs.en: I open the door.

rows.jp: 背後から目覚ましのアラームと、
rows.en: Behind me, the alarm goes off, followed by—

ghs.en: From behind my back, I could hear the sound of the alarm clock,

rows.jp: 「んあっ？」
rows.en: “Ngh?!”

ghs.en: Misato: "nMah?"

rows.jp: 先輩の奇声が聞こえた。
rows.en: Mimi’s startled squawk.

ghs.en: and Senpai making an odd voice.

rows.jp: 小さく微笑んで、背後で扉を閉めた。
rows.en: With a faint smile, I close the door behind me.

ghs.en: With a tiny little smile, I close the door behind my back.
